question: What claim about the totality of yoginīs is at stake in presenting the whole field-group of all earth-moving and all sky-moving yoginīs?
premises: Together they form a single all-field group.
inference: The totality of earth-moving and sky-moving yoginīs is presented as one complete field-group.
plain_english: This is the whole field-group of all earth-moving and all sky-moving yoginīs.
